title: New LUCI Launch Campaign
objective: Launch the new LUCI publicly, drive customer upgrades, re-engage warm leads, and generate net-new demand.
lede: One coordinated launch with three audience paths.

channels.name: Website (updated)
channels.role: The LUCI story, new capabilities, proof, search, and a path to a demo. The primary surface for customers and for new leads arriving from any channel.

channels.name: LinkedIn (organic)
channels.role: Launch announcements and capability posts. Reaches customers and prospects already aware of LUCI; supports every audience path.

channels.name: Email
channels.role: Direct outreach across every audience path: customer announcements, warm-lead re-engagement series, and inbound demo response.

channels.name: Newsletter (The Signal)
channels.role: Ongoing nurture that keeps LUCI present with customers and warm leads between launches; doubles as the warm-lead nurture track.

streams.name: Existing customers
streams.audience: Operations and IT at current LUCI properties.
streams.promise: See what is new and how to upgrade.
streams.objective: Move current properties to the new version on an upgrade schedule that works for each operation.
streams.strategy: Launch alongside the public campaign with a direct customer path: what changed, why it matters, and what to expect during the upgrade.
streams.story: The LUCI that gave you full property control now gives you increased operational precision—finer ways to tune your A/V to the spaces, timing, and workflows of every location.
assets: What's New one-pager: what changed and why it matters to a property already on LUCI.
Upgrade guide and FAQ: timing, preparation, responsibilities, and what happens during the upgrade.
IT companion: how New LUCI sits above the property's existing A/V environment.
Internal talking points for the field.

primary.name: Venue panels
primary.text: Control in the space, scoped to the venue.

primary.name: Staging
primary.text: Build the next look while the current one keeps running.

primary.name: Audit trails and in-product support
primary.text: Every action recorded. Start a support request from the device, incident, or error—with the relevant context already attached.

primary.name: Customizable interface
primary.text: The visual reveal: property photography, marks, colors.

streams.alsoInRelease: Audio group control. A live map that reflects the floor. Add any endpoint from LUCI. Email, PIN, or Entra sign-in. Video wall layouts pulled from the processor. A central catalog of hospitality display models, pushed to the property.
streams.measures: Upgrades scheduled and completed; feature adoption at 90 days; recurring support questions.

streams.name: Warm leads
streams.audience: Prospects who requested or completed a demo, and are not in an active sales conversation.
streams.objective: Re-engage prospects who have seen LUCI but gone quiet, and move them back into a sales conversation.
streams.strategy: Use the launch to reopen quiet conversations with prospects who have already shown interest. Active opportunities remain in the sales cadence.
streams.story: LUCI now puts more control in the venue, makes complex changes safer to prepare, and gives operations and IT a clearer record of what happened.
assets: Re-engagement email series (3–4 emails) after a form with no reply.
Re-engagement email series (3–4 emails) after a demo with no next step.
Ongoing nurture — likely The Signal newsletter — to stay present without a separate track.
Proof pull: consolidation numbers across running properties (displays, zones, walls, racks removed), not new-feature-specific.
Sales handoff prompt: a reply or a meeting ends the track.
streams.measures: Re-engaged conversations; demos re-booked; deals advanced.

streams.name: Demand gen
streams.audience: Casino and property A/V and IT who are not already in a conversation with us.
streams.promise: Meet the full LUCI platform through the updated website and campaign.
streams.objective: Generate qualified interest and demos from prospects who have not encountered LUCI.
streams.strategy: Earn attention through search and targeted paid social, then convert it on the website. The updated site and a new blog carry the story and the SEO surface; paid LinkedIn puts it in front of the right titles at mid-size casinos; outbound supports the prospects Mark is already working.
streams.story: Separate A/V systems create separate workflows, vendors, and points of failure. LUCI consolidates them into one operating environment, with a team that stays.
assets: Blog, launching with the new website — the SEO and thought-leadership surface.
SEO program: search-driven discovery of LUCI's capabilities and consolidation story.
Paid LinkedIn ads targeting c-suite, VP, and Director levels at mid-size casinos.
Outbound sequence supporting Mark's existing prospecting cadence.
Inbound demo response and nurture emails.
Events (2027): develop an event strategy and presence as a longer-term demand-generation initiative.
streams.measures: Inbound leads by source; qualified opportunities; demos booked; pipeline created.
